data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to listen for Android volume button presses and block default behavior.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stream of hardware volume button events on Android. While listening, the buttons are prevented from changing the system volume. Stops listening restores normal button functionality.
use_when: You need to react to volume up/down presses in a Flutter app on Android
You want to intercept volume keys for custom shortcuts or UI controls
avoid_when: The app must run on iOS or other platforms
You need the volume buttons to keep controlling the system volume
strengths: Simple API with a Dart stream
weaknesses: Requires MainActivity to extend a custom class
Blocks normal volume control while active
data.setup_notes: Change MainActivity.java or MainActivity.kt to extend FlutterAndroidVolumeKeydownActivity
